map.多种仓位管理方法：凯利公式、固定比例、风险预算等: Multiple position-sizing methods: Kelly criterion, fixed fraction, risk budgeting, etc.
map.固定比例法：仓位 = 账户资金 × 可承受风险比例 / 止损幅度；凯利公式 f*: Fixed-fraction method: position = account capital × acceptable risk ratio / stop-loss distance; Kelly formula f* = (bp − q)/b
map.基于资金管理模型：按可承受风险与止损幅度确定单笔仓位；凯利公式给出理论最优下注比: Based on a money-management model: determine the single-trade size from acceptable risk and stop-loss distance; the Kelly formula gives the theoretically optimal bet fraction (in practice halve it conservatively to absorb estimation error), for trade risk control.
map.b = 盈亏比（平均盈利/平均亏损）: b = payoff ratio (avg win / avg loss)
map.f = p - q/b = 胜率 - 败率/盈亏比: f = p − q/b = win rate − loss rate / payoff ratio
map.实际应用中常用\"半凯利\"（乘以0.5），降低波动: In practice the "half-Kelly" (×0.5) is commonly used to reduce volatility
map.每次买入固定比例的资金，不考虑胜率和盈亏比: Buy a fixed fraction of capital each time, ignoring win rate and payoff ratio
map.仓位金额 = 总资产 × 固定比例: Position amount = total assets × fixed fraction
map.持股数量 = 仓位金额 ÷ 买入价格: Share count = position amount ÷ buy price
map.风险金额 = 持股数量 × (买入价 - 止损价): Risk amount = share count × (buy price − stop-loss price)
map.简单易用，适合新手: Simple and easy to use, good for beginners
map.单票5%-15%，同时持有3-10只: 5%–15% per position, holding 3–10 names at once
map.根据单笔最大亏损比例反推仓位大小: Back-solve position size from the max per-trade loss ratio
map.单笔最大亏损 = 总资产 × 单笔风险比例: Max per-trade loss = total assets × per-trade risk ratio
map.每股风险 = 买入价 - 止损价: Risk per share = buy price − stop-loss price
map.持股数量 = 单笔最大亏损 ÷ 每股风险: Share count = max per-trade loss ÷ risk per share
map.仓位金额 = 持股数量 × 买入价: Position amount = share count × buy price
map.亏损后加倍下注，期望一次盈利弥补之前亏损: After a loss, double the bet, expecting one win to recover prior losses
map.只要不一直加仓，最终盈利可回本盈利: As long as you don't keep adding, a final win recovers and profits
map.资金可能耗尽，需谨慎使用: Capital may be exhausted; use with caution
map.不要把鸡蛋放在一个篮子里: Don't put all your eggs in one basket
map.每笔交易必须设止损，严格执行: Every trade must set a stop loss and follow it strictly
map.盈利时加仓，亏损时减仓: Add when profitable, reduce when losing
map.仓位大小与风险承受能力匹配: Position size should match risk tolerance
map.亏损加仓可能导致深度套牢: Adding on losses may lead to deep drawdown
map.没有自己的交易系统: No trading system of your own
map.新手建议从模拟交易练习仓位管理: Beginners should practice position sizing with simulated trading
map.建立自己的交易系统并严格执行: Build your own trading system and follow it strictly
map.记录每笔交易的理由和结果: Record the rationale and outcome of every trade
map.定期复盘，总结经验教训: Review regularly and learn from experience
map.保持学习，持续优化交易系统: Keep learning and continuously refine your system
map.闲钱投资，不影响生活: Invest idle money only; don't affect your living
map.用凯利公式、固定比例或风险预算法测算建议仓位: Estimate suggested position with Kelly, fixed fraction or risk budget
map.按止损幅度反推可开仓的数量与金额: Back-solve tradable quantity and amount from stop-loss distance
map.控制单笔风险占总资金的比例: Control per-trade risk as a share of total capital
map.凯利比例 f=(2×0.55-0.45)/2 = 0.325，即建议仓位约 32: Kelly fraction f=(2×0.55−0.45)/2 = 0.325, i.e. suggested position ≈ 32.5%; in practice half-Kelly (≈16%) is used to reduce drawdown.
map.凯利公式怎么用？: How to use the Kelly formula?
map.最优比例 f=(bp-q)/b（b 为盈亏比、p 为胜率、q=1-p）；实务常用: Optimal fraction f=(bp−q)/b (b = payoff ratio, p = win rate, q=1−p); in practice half-Kelly or quarter-Kelly is used to reduce volatility.
map.固定比例法与风险预算法有什么区别？: What is the difference between fixed-fraction and risk-budget methods?
map.固定比例按总资金固定: Fixed fraction allocates a fixed share of total capital
map.开仓；风险预算法先定单笔可承受亏损，再按止损幅度反推仓位，风险更可控。: ; the risk-budget method first sets the per-trade bearable loss, then back-solves position from stop-loss distance, making risk more controllable.
map.不安全。凯利假设参数准确，实际胜率与盈亏比难以精确估计，满凯利回撤极大，建议只取: No. Kelly assumes accurate parameters; actual win rate and payoff are hard to estimate precisely, and full Kelly has huge drawdown—use only a fractional Kelly.
map.仓位计算器是一款金融财务领域的在线工具。输入账户资金、单笔可承受风险与止损幅度，: Position Size Calculator is an online tool in the finance domain. Enter account capital, per-trade acceptable risk and stop-loss distance; the tool uses Kelly, fixed fraction or risk budget to compute the suggested position size, assisting trade money management.
map.* 凯利公式是理论最优值，实际使用建议用半凯利更稳健: * The Kelly formula is the theoretical optimum; in practice, half-Kelly is more robust
